name: Outcast Stone Giant

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The stone giant makes two attacks: one with its Stone Club and one with its Boulder. It can replace one attack with a use of Answer the Roar.

actions.name: Stone Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (7d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Answer the Roar
actions.description: One creature within 240 feet of the stone giant must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the stone giant until the end of its next turn.

generation.userConcept: a stone giant exile who speaks only Giant and understands no Common
